title: Witness burns as blue-shifted light from a warp bubble

tellings.quote: well, that sounds like visible band light being blue shifted into the ultraviolet and you're getting literally a sunburn.

plain: David Grusch, a former intelligence official who says the US holds recovered craft, tells podcast host Jesse Michels his idea for why some witnesses get burned near these objects. He suggests the craft may sit inside a warp bubble, a pocket of bent space, which squeezes ordinary visible light into ultraviolet light, so people end up with what is literally a sunburn. If true, it would tie witness injuries to the way the craft move.
